hypothesis: Material/Stockfish scores saturating close to -1 make uncertain disadvantage numerically almost equivalent to a demonstrated FOW terminal loss. Reserve a terminal-value gap without changing terminal rules.
scope: Scale every uncertain nonterminal root/child heuristic, including fallback internal scores and bounded Stockfish values. Child-backed alternate values and carried blueprints derive from the same scaled game. Proven terminals unchanged.
pilot: Same two forced-loss prevention seats plus d01/s18 controls; 2 seeds, 2 evaluators, paired scales 1/.9, cold prefix, .5 seconds, 128 roots, 20000 parents. 32 decisions.
screen: Require consistent prevention improvement on both seeds of at least one evaluator/case, no new immediate loss on either control seat, all protocol/snapshot/evaluator checks passing. This screens a broader gate, not Elo.
limitation: A fixed gap is uncalibrated; changing value semantics may hurt tactical winning play. Any passing pilot still needs broad control seats, searched prefixes and on-policy 180+2 matches.
